policy.description: ISM policy for events data streams. Rolls over backing indices at 20 GB per primary shard (or 200,000,000 documents), then deletes each rolled-over index 1 day after it rolled over, so the previous index is always kept at least that long. Deployments that never fill a shard never roll over and retain events indefinitely. This is a Wazuh default policy: it is restored on every restart, so do not edit it. To change it, edit the copy of this policy in the configuration directory of the setup plugin and set policies.stream-events-policy.custom to true in setup.yml: https://wazuh.github.io/wazuh-indexer-plugins/ref/modules/setup/customization.html#ism-policies
